name: National Family Benefit Scheme
target_group: Eligible BPL households where the primary breadwinner aged 18–59 has died
eligibility: Family and breadwinner conditions must meet current NSAP rules.
benefits: Lump-sum central assistance of ₹20,000 to the eligible surviving household head under the scheme.
application_process: Apply through the state/UT authority implementing NSAP.
source: Ministry of Rural Development / Government of India
